text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek trains hard in<n>preparation for the
Sumire Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She vows to win three races in the<n>Classics just to
make me smile.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that goal in mind, she continues<n>to secretly put
in extra effort to further<n>her abilities.
